summary.text: Candace Newell is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 99, representing Orleans, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Candace Newell's occupation as Attorney.
It lists Candace Newell's education as B.A., Psychology; M.S., Criminal Justice; J.D..
The House member page lists Candace Newell's committee assignments as Commerce; House and Governmental Affairs; Judiciary; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Orleans Delegation.
